_help: PLAYORA game catalog. To add a game: 1) put its files in games/<id>/ (index.html + thumb.svg or thumb.webp) 2) add an entry below 3) push to GitHub. See ADDING-GAMES.md for every field.

games.title: NIGHT SHIFT: The Abandoned Hospital
games.description: A first-person 3D horror survival game. You wake inside a dark, abandoned hospital overrun by the infected. With a failing flashlight and a pistol, explore wards, operating rooms and a secret underground lab across four chapters, fight walkers, runners and worse, uncover the truth behind the outbreak and escape alive.
games.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look (click to lock the mouse), Shift to sprint, Space to jump, E to interact, F flashlight, left click to shoot, R to reload, H to use a medkit, Tab for inventory and notes, Esc to pause. Headphones recommended.

games.title: Head Cup
games.description: Big heads, big goals. Pick one of 14 original players and a national team, choose one of 14 wild skills like Fireball, Freeze or Giant Keeper, and play 1 vs CPU, 2 players on one keyboard, or 2 vs 2.
games.controls: Player 1: A / D move, W jump, S or F kick, Q skill. Player 2: arrow keys to move and jump, 0 or Enter kick, Right Shift skill. Gamepads and touch buttons also work. Esc pauses.

games.title: Chaos Duel
games.description: Two players, one keyboard, one arena gone wild. Pick Bruno the tank or Zippy the speedster and fight best of three while Chaos Events flip the rules: low gravity, ice, meteor rain, giant fists and a shrinking arena.
games.controls: Player 1: A / D move, W jump, S block, F punch, G heavy, H special (H + direction to dash). Player 2: arrow keys to move, jump and block, K punch, L heavy, ; special. Esc pauses.

games.title: Comet Catcher
games.description: Steer your little star-ship across the night sky, scoop up glowing comets and dodge the falling space rocks. The longer you survive, the faster the sky gets. How high can your score climb?
games.controls: Move with the arrow keys or A / D. On a phone or tablet, drag your finger left and right. Catch comets for points, avoid the grey rocks. You have 3 lives. Press P to pause.

games.title: Brick Blitz
games.description: Bounce the energy ball, smash every neon brick and keep it alive with your paddle. Each level adds tougher bricks that take more than one hit. Clear the board to move on.
games.controls: Move the paddle with the mouse, the arrow keys, or by dragging on touch screens. Press Space or tap to launch the ball. Press P to pause.

games.title: Glyph Match
games.description: Flip the cards and find every matching pair of glowing glyphs. Fewer moves and a faster time mean more stars. Three board sizes, from a relaxed warm-up to a real memory workout.
games.controls: Click or tap a card to flip it. Find two matching cards to keep them face up. Match all pairs to win.

games.title: Paddle Duel
games.description: A fast two-player duel on one screen. Grab a friend, take a side and keep the puck out of your goal. First to 7 points wins. Playing alone? Switch on the computer opponent.
games.controls: Left player: W / S. Right player: arrow Up / Down. On touch screens, each player drags on their own half of the screen. Press 1 for one player vs computer, 2 for two players.

games.title: Turbo Lanes
games.description: Weave through traffic on a neon highway, collect boost cells and chase the perfect run. Coming soon to PLAYORA.

games.title: Lantern Path
games.description: Guide a small lantern spirit through a forest of shadows, solving light puzzles to find the way home. Coming soon to PLAYORA.

games.title: Goal Rush
games.description: Line up your shot, beat the keeper and climb the tournament ladder in quick penalty showdowns. Coming soon to PLAYORA.

games.title: Tower Tactics
games.description: Build and upgrade towers to hold the line against waves of mischievous robots. Coming soon to PLAYORA.
